title: feat(nsxe2xinc): x-axis opposite ±e_2 x-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Same seed as #7195 read on x-probes instead of y-probes, so A=(1,0,0) is a seed (t=0, L=-e_2) and reverse_hold_channel=uses_L_A. Second of the three cells where the own-lock union carries the result; the pair (#7195,#7196) shows the channel is a property of the probe frame, not of the seed.
